description:
Software Engineer - Clinical Analytics 

 Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values .   

 This position is based out of our headquarters in the Greater Seattle area. #LI-hybrid   

 Who We Need   

 Truveta is building a diverse and inclusive team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. We are seeking enthusiastic new graduates who are problem-solvers, collaborative teammates, and eager to make a difference in healthcare. If you’re excited about purposeful work, joining a mission-driven team, and launching your career in a supportive environment, Truveta could be the perfect place to start.   

 This Opportunity   

 At Truveta, you'll help health systems turn clinical data into better care. You'll work at the intersection of cloud services, analytical data platforms, and user experiences, building technology that lets clinical and quality teams define, monitor, and act on the metrics that matter most.   

 Health systems deserve modern, intuitive tools for measuring care quality. Too often, getting answers from large-scale clinical data requires specialized skills and long turnaround times. At Truveta, we are building a next-generation analytics platform that lets health systems securely explore their data, track performance over time, and drive measurable improvements in patient outcomes.   

 We are seeking a Software Engineer to design, build, and operate the services behind Truveta's clinical analytics experiences. You will develop scalable cloud services, APIs, and analytical data infrastructure, and contribute across the stack to deliver secure, reliable, high-performance solutions that make self-serve analytics a reality for health systems.   

 You will work closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering teams to translate the needs of clinical and quality leaders into intuitive, scalable experiences. This role offers the chance to solve challenging technical problems, shape the future of Truveta's analytics platform, and make a meaningful impact on our mission of saving lives with data.   

 Work Areas: 

 
 Build analytics infrastructure that serves population-level health data with low latency, so health systems can interactively explore and slice large datasets. 

 Design and build self-serve dashboarding capabilities that enable health systems to define, customize, and share the metrics they use to monitor care quality. 

 Develop services and APIs for metric definition, computation, and monitoring, with strong tenant isolation, access control, and data security. 

 Optimize query performance and data modeling (aggregation strategies, caching, and storage layout) to deliver fast, reliable analytics at scale. 

 Partner with Product, Design, and Data teams to turn clinical quality use cases into well-scoped, production-ready features.   

 
 Key Qualifications   

 
 BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

 2+ years of experience building, deploying, and operating scalable cloud services using .NET (C#), Python, or a similar language. 

 Experience with data, OLAP, or analytics technologies, such as analytical databases, BI and dashboarding tools, or data modeling for reporting workloads. 

 Solid backend development experience with REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native architectures on platforms such as Azure. 

 Working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of query performance and data modeling tradeoffs. 

 Ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams and deliver end-to-end solutions.   

 
 Preferred Qualifications   

 
 Experience building embedded analytics, dashboarding, or other data-driven products for technical or business users.   

 Familiarity with multi-tenant architectures, including row-level security and tenant data isolation.   

 Familiarity with healthcare data, clinical quality measures, or health informatics.   

 Experience with containerized deployments, observability, and operating production services.   

 
 Why Truveta?   

 Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together.   

 We Offer:   

 
 Interesting and meaningful work for every career stage   

 Great benefits package   

 Comprehensive benefits with strong medical, dental and vision insurance plans   

 401K plan   

 Professional development & training opportunities for continuous learning   

 Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off   

 Generous parental leave   

 Regular team activities (virtual and in-person)   

 The base pay for this position is $110,000 to $145,000. The pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target. Pay is based on several factors including location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles are eligible for additional compensation such as incentive pay and stock options.   

 
 If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here.   

 Truveta is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and empowering workplace. We believe that having employees, interns, and contractors with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world. We recognize that opportunities in technology historically excluded and continue to disproportionately exclude Black and Indigenous people, people of color, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people. We strongly encourage individuals with these identities to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements.   

 Please note that all applicants must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer as we are unable to sponsor work visas or permits (e.g., F ‑ 1 OPT, H ‑ 1B) at this time. We appreciate your interest in the position and encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.
